purpose: Evidence-scoped Gate 0 inventory for Genesis-native game-art and 3D production. This is a partial inventory, not a claim that the entire repository has been exhaustively mapped.

verification.rule: File/blob inspection is not proof of runtime integration; CI status is not inferred.

ssot_policy.rule: Extend canonical Genesis modules first. Do not add parallel renderer, asset, animation, or editor implementations unless an ownership/dependency audit proves a distinct missing responsibility.

entries.responsibility: Defines Rust workspace and canonical module membership.
evidence_gaps: Workspace membership alone does not prove runtime integration or tests.

entries.responsibility: Shared contracts and value types between engine subsystems.
evidence_gaps: Renderer contract only submits entity transforms; no mesh/material/draw packet contract in this file.
No concrete native GPU or software renderer established by this contract.

entries.responsibility: Backend abstraction, null backend, deterministic command collection, Renderer adapter.
evidence_gaps: Vulkan/Metal/DirectX12/OpenGL/WebGpu are enum variants, not proof of implemented drivers.
CommandBufferBackend reports GraphicsBackend::Null and compute=true; capability semantics require correction/audit.
No clipping, triangle rasterization, depth buffer, shading, or image-output implementation established by this file.

entries.responsibility: Renderer-facing resource handles and entity-to-resource bindings.
evidence_gaps: Need inspect complete resource lifecycle, ownership, upload, validation and texture resolution.

entries.responsibility: Collect world transforms and resource bindings into render items.
evidence_gaps: Observed path leaves texture and instance-group data unset; prove full mesh/material-to-pixel flow.

entries.responsibility: Bridge sampled animation poses into renderer-side pose representation.
evidence_gaps: Pose mapping does not prove vertex skinning, inverse-bind handling, CPU/GPU deformation or rendered animated output.

entries.responsibility: In-memory asset registry, import metadata, dependency validation/order, mesh data and validation.
evidence_gaps: FNV-1a 64-bit is not a cryptographic integrity digest.
Need prove canonical serialized formats, material/texture codecs, cook outputs, dependency invalidation and reproducible import/build.
Asset store observed is in-memory; persistent production storage not established by this file.

entries.responsibility: Skeleton/clip/track data structures and deterministic pose sampling.
evidence_gaps: Validation coverage for cycles, duplicate track targets, key ordering, non-finite values and invalid durations must be tested.
Quaternion interpolation is normalized linear interpolation; production interpolation requirements need explicit specification.
IK, retargeting, animation graphs and deformation pipeline are not established by this file.

entries.responsibility: Scene document model, transform editing, basic undo, world application and text serialization.
evidence_gaps: This file does not prove a native visual Studio shell, 3D viewport, gizmos, mesh editing, material editor, or animation timeline.
Parent graph cycle/transform hierarchy and serialization edge cases require tests.

entries.responsibility: Build profile metadata, package file collection, artifact metadata/checksum and manifest serialization.
evidence_gaps: Need prove canonical manifest serialization, artifact digest verification, deterministic build outputs and Windows/Linux packaging in CI.

exit_criteria: Record exact commit and blob SHAs
Validated asset manifest and cryptographic digests
Resource lifetime and error handling tests
Native Studio viewport and authoring UX

next_actions: Expand inventory across renderer module files, asset formats/importers, editor UI, runtime/render loop, tests and platform-specific code.
Audit actual dependency graph and identify current render loop ownership.
Correct or explicitly document CommandBufferBackend capability semantics.
Specify deterministic software rasterizer contract and reference-image format before implementation.
Run targeted workspace tests only through an environment that returns verifiable run/job/step/exit-code evidence.
